__comment: Plump Helmet — the primary underground crop and brewing staple of a dwarven colony.
Grows on cave soil farm plots in complete darkness. No sunlight required.
Biologically accurate: mushrooms grow from mycelium in damp organic soil, not from
planted seeds. This is modelled via auto_reseed: true — after harvest the farm manager
automatically resets the plot to 'sprouting' without dwarf intervention. No seed item exists.
PLACEMENT: Cave soil farm plots only (base:terrain:soil:cave).
3 clear air blocks above required for dwarf access.
SEASONS: No seasonal variation — underground plots are unaffected by WorldClock season.
Only 'summer' model keys are defined; missing season keys fall back to 'summer'
sprouting: 6 in-game days → advances to mature.
mature: final stage; stays until harvested.
After harvest: plot returns to FALLOW, then auto-reseeds to sprouting.
YIELD: 4× plump_helmet per harvest. No cutting or seed drop needed.
